risks: The ~51-spec import codemod (helpers→lib + deeper folders) is the highest-risk change: one missed relative path throws at COLLECTION, which silently zeroes a whole project run — the exact failure class as the CI=true/webServer incident. Mitigate: codemod in one commit, then `playwright test --list` per project + run THE GATE before moving on.

Playwright projects use filename-regex testMatch; the visual-vlm→vlm-evaluation rename must be mirrored in BOTH the vlm project testMatch AND the default project testIgnore, or the heavy VLM spec leaks into the fast smoke project (or the vlm project matches nothing).

Report-only specs resolve artifact output by path; moving them into deeper subfolders can shift __dirname-relative writes (showcase per-viewport dirs, scale-sweep JSON). Verify all output roots resolve from repo root, not the spec's directory.

balance_metrics.py is referenced by string path from two specs AND by Cloud audit-kit (BALANCE_PY); moving it can break Cloud's layout metrics, and audit-kit's graceful-degrade may hide the breakage. Grep both repos for the old path.

Deleting oauth-linkedin.spec.ts removes the only importer of mock-oauth-server.ts + oauth fixtures; they are retained ONLY because admin/oauth-provider-config keeps using them — confirm that before deleting, else also delete the lib+fixture.
Deleting database-connectivity.spec.ts removes one of two api.ts consumers; api-health.spec.ts still needs api.ts — do not delete api.ts.

test:pr / test:comprehensive are public surface (CLAUDE.md, ./start test, CI prod-smoke). Repointing to the unified harness changes their output location and exit semantics; CI prod-smoke is advisory (continue-on-error) so a harness regression there is silent.

Cloud is a submodule pinned to a Core commit. Promoting libs into Core means Cloud imports break until its submodule pointer is bumped — cross-repo ordering hazard; sequence Core-first, then Cloud bump.

Heavy sequences (matrix ~100 cells, showcase 5 viewports, scale-sweep up to 2000 nodes, VLM GPU) must stay OUT of the blocking smoke/pr profiles or local + CI gate runs time out; keep them report-only/full-profile.

Legacy report path test-results/reports/index.html is referenced by ./start test, Makefile test-report, and CLAUDE.md; missing these leaves dead links after the harness moves output to test-artifacts/unified.
Folding Cloud report.mjs into reporting/html.mjs must preserve the embedded-base64-screenshot path so Cloud's portable single-file report still works; regression here breaks shareable audit reports.

Drop/neutralize their npm scripts. Verify: gate green; `playwright test --list` shows only keepers.

Verify: gate green via the renamed path; each PW project --list resolves; test:mobile (tag-driven) green.

Phase 4 — Fold the 4 report generators into adapters and port the loose-JS keepers to specs (tls-certificate-cross-browser, mobile/tls-compat). Wire report:showcase/report:matrix/test:vlm/test:perf:scale + test:pr/test:comprehensive through run-unified.mjs. Verify: each report sequence emits into test-artifacts/unified with embedded video+images; gate still green.

Phase 5 — Cross-repo: promote audit-kit/schema-contract/schema-coverage + report renderer into Core tests/lib/{audit,reporting}, move verify-camera-fix.mjs + generate-audit-report.mjs into Core scripts, add the cloud-audit adapter, add verify:prod-build + audit:report. Then bump GraphDone-Cloud's core/ submodule and re-point its live-audit/verify-live imports. Verify: Cloud verify-live still passes; Core audit:report renders from a sample findings.json.

Phase 6 — Docs + final cleanup. Update CLAUDE.md testing section, ./start test, Makefile test-report, tests/lib/README.md to the new layout/paths; delete tests/_draft_unified and any _archive. Final full run: npm run test:unified (full profile) + THE GATE green.
